agent.rule.K2: No breeze, so no neighbour is a pit.
agent.rule.K3: No stench, so no neighbour hides a Wumpus.
agent.rule.K4: A breeze means at least one of these neighbours is a pit.
agent.rule.K5: A stench means at least one of these neighbours hides a Wumpus.
agent.rule.K6: Only one candidate is left in the clause, so it must be true.
agent.rule.K8: There is only one Wumpus: it must be where all stenches overlap.
agent.rule.K9: The single Wumpus is found, so every other cell is Wumpus-free.
agent.rule.K10: The arrow flew without a scream, so its path has no Wumpus.
agent.rule.K11: A scream: the arrow killed the first Wumpus in its path.

help.title: How to play
help.intro: Explore a dark cave. You only know what you sense on your current cell.
help.breeze: Breeze: a pit is in a neighbouring cell. Falling in ends the game.
help.stench: Stench: a living Wumpus is next to you. Shoot it with an arrow, it flies in a straight line.
help.glitter: Glitter: gold is on this cell. Grab it!
help.scream: Scream: your arrow killed a Wumpus.
help.goal: Easy: grab the gold, return to (0,0) and climb out. Normal and Hard: collect all the gold.
help.agent: Switch to AI Agent mode to watch a logic agent explore and explain its reasoning step by step.
